desc.ian_image_library:title: Acridotheres tristis (Common Myna)
desc.ian_image_library:descr: Illustration of Acridotheres tristis (Common Myna), which is an invasive pest in South Africa, North America, the Middle East, Australia, New Zealand and many Pacific islands as it out-competes native hollow-nesting bird species.
